EndoscopyCT & MRIVital signsProjects

Endoscopic video, live in XR

View live video from Olympus, STORZ and other endoscopy systems in XR.

Wireless or direct connection

Receive video wirelessly or connect a capture device directly to suit the operating room setup.

2D and 3D video

View standard endoscopic video in 2D and stereoscopic video from 3D endoscopes.

Video input and reception tests — Coming soonVideo development notes — Coming soon

CT and MRI slices, with 3D models

Browse image slices and move, rotate or resize 3D models.

Browse image slices

CT and MRI DICOM data are processed on a Mac into image slices, organized by study and series for browsing in XR.

View and position 3D models

VTK generates 3D surface models from CT data for use in XR. Separately prepared anatomical models can also be loaded, moved, rotated and resized.

CT and MRI development notes — Coming soonApp demonstrations — Coming soon

Vital signs alongside the video

View vital sign readings and waveforms alongside surgical video.

Waveforms and compact readings

ECG, plethysmography and respiration waveforms appear in a dedicated panel. Heart rate, SpO₂ and respiratory rate can also be shown as a compact overlay on the video.

After communication tests with the MX850, numeric data reception was confirmed with the MX750 and MX800. Reception of all three waveforms was then logged on Galaxy XR.
